answer: Model every identity as a point on a trust map built from real, cross-verified interactions. Honest agents extend a jetty of verified edges into the wider network; a sybil ring sits across a canyon, densely linked to itself but bridged to the honest world by almost nothing. Score each identity by how far its vouches reach on an independent voyage through the graph, and a thousand fakes huddled on one shore collectively weigh no more than one.
